<thought>To determine the number of CH₃ groups, the simplest approach is to examine the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample. Methyl protons appear as signals around 0.8–1.2 ppm, typically integrating to three protons per CH₃. By retrieving the proton NMR data, I can count distinct methyl signals (or integration values) and thus infer the number of CH₃ groups. No other information is provided, so I will request the proton NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
